_note: What is used up is refilled: a tree, rock or bush that is used up is gone and the share given here of them (by the level of the player's campfire, 1 to 4) appear again 4 to 11 tiles from it, at least respawnMinDist tiles from the fire of the village and two tiles from any house. The first levels give back most of it, so that a new village is never left with bare ground round it; later less, so that the people go farther for what they need (searchRadius is how far they look). exploreReach: when no source of what they gather is left in the land already seen, the gatherers go out by themselves to look: to a spot this many tiles from the fire (by its level), unexplored ground first, as the hunters do; walking there opens the map.
